notes: The three golden worlds (CLAUDE.md; simulation-core/tests/determinism.rs; cz-web/tests/native.rs and wasm.rs) as a design: `dynamics_hash` after 200 ticks must be Forager 0x658ee873d1866501, Learner (32 rows) 0xcb8bc0a9772c09a4, institution world 0xfedc281503180c8e. The institution world is `institution_preset` (nomos_preset, 128-row learners, enforcers held at 100 permille), every tenth founder an Enforcer, the first-occupancy norm Encroach { standing 32, sanction HARM = 1 } decreed at tick 100 (the assembly carried the same norm at tick 51, so the decree replaces rule 0). The expected values are pinned in crates/cz-lab/tests/goldens.rs; cz-lab-web (5-8) reads this file for the same check under wasm.
